title: Mastaa wa K-pop huinua nywele za mbele na kuacha nyuzi chache pembeni ili uso uonekane mdogo
label: Mtindo wa nywele wa mastaa wa K-pop

text.I want to share a little trivia I heard: Ninataka kushiriki dokezo dogo nililosikia kutoka kwa mtengeneza nywele wangu saluni.
text.Up, With Strands: Juu, huku nyuzi chache zikibaki pembeni
text.Korean idols these days push their bangs: Siku hizi mastaa wa K-pop huinua nywele zao za mbele, sivyo?
text.But they leave really just 3 or 4, or ab: Lakini huacha kwa makusudi nyuzi 3 au 4 tu, au takriban 10 za pembeni zining’inie.
text.💫 A close-up of the hairstyle: 💫 Picha ya karibu ya mtindo wa nywele
text.Why do they do this? It seems that by le: Kwa nini hufanya hivyo? Inaonekana kuacha takriban nyuzi tatu pembeni hufanya uso uonekane mdogo.
text.It seems your face looks smaller, a bit: Uso huonekana mdogo na mwembamba kidogo, na unatoa mwonekano mzuri zaidi.
text.If I feel like it, maybe next time I wil: Nikijisikia, labda wakati mwingine nitajaribu kuacha nyuzi chache kando ya nywele zangu za mbele.
